label: CRM migration, Vietnamese & Japanese data
text: Hi team, Kaito Freight is leaving Salesforce. We need about 150,000 accounts and contacts moved into Kestrel in 3 weeks. Our sales offices are in Hanoi and Tokyo, so a lot of names are in Vietnamese and Japanese. Can you confirm the plan?

label: Azure AD SSO + same-day leavers
text: Our CISO wants single sign-on through Microsoft Entra / Azure AD for 4,000 staff, and anyone who leaves must lose access the same day. We need this live in two weeks for an audit.

label: Slow dashboard at quarter-end
text: Every quarter-end our portfolio dashboard becomes painfully slow, sometimes a minute to load. Finance is furious. Please investigate urgently.

label: 5,000 LPs signing subscription docs
text: We are launching Fund IV and need 5,000 limited partners to e-sign subscription documents in Kestrel. Legal is still editing the agreement. First close is in 15 working days.

label: Workday integration (new system)
text: Could Kestrel pull new hires and terminations from Workday every night so that user accounts are created and removed automatically?

label: Website translation (never done)
text: Can your team translate our public marketing website into French and German before our trade show next month?
